scope: Separate CUDA PyTorch/PEFT FP16 performance path on the unchanged 824 V7 training pairs. The same weighted next-token objective retains full context; projection changes 512 to 192, backend/precision/gradient scaling/checkpointing differ. This is not an isolated GPU hardware speed comparison, a fresh held-out experiment, or evidence of accuracy. Smoke weights are discarded.

dependency_environment.torchao_policy: Must be genuinely uninstalled; no import masking or module stubbing.

token_audit.projection_difference: Only zero-weight logits omitted; no input token or supervised target dropped.

initializer_audit.dequant_arithmetic: BF16-rounded multiply followed by BF16-rounded add; MLX CPU dequant reference

timing_scope: Synchronized run wall time includes report/checkpoint/export/audit overhead; excludes model loading/tokenization and is not kernel-only time.
